verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א צֹ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ׀ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־ שֻׁדַּ֤ד מִבַּ֙יִת֙ מִבּ֔וֹא נִגְלָה־ לָֽמוֹ׃ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כִּתִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ṣōr hê·lî·lū ’o·nî·yō·wṯ tar·šîš kî- šud·daḏ mib·ba·yiṯ mib·bō·w niḡ·lāh- lā·mōw mê·’e·reṣ kit·tîm
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against Tyre Wail O ships of Tarshish for [Tyre] is laid waste without house [or] harbor Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus

verses.original: דֹּ֖מּוּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אִ֑י סֹחֵ֥ר צִיד֛וֹן עֹבֵ֥ר מִלְאֽוּךְ׃ יָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: dōm·mū yō·šə·ḇê ’î sō·ḥêr ṣî·ḏō·wn ‘ō·ḇêr mil·’ūḵ yām
verses.literal: Be silent O dwellers of the coastland you merchants of Sidon whose traders have crossed the sea

verses.original: רַבִּים֙ וּבְמַ֤יִם זֶ֣רַע שִׁחֹ֔ר קְצִ֥יר יְא֖וֹר תְּבֽוּאָתָ֑הּ וַתְּהִ֖י סְחַ֥ר גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm ū·ḇə·ma·yim ze·ra‘ ši·ḥōr qə·ṣîr yə·’ō·wr tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯāh wat·tə·hî sə·ḥar gō·w·yim
verses.literal: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre she was the merchant of the nations

verses.original: בּ֣וֹשִׁי צִיד֔וֹן מָע֥וֹז יָ֔ם כִּֽי־ הַיָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אָמַ֣ר לֹֽא־ חַ֣לְתִּי יָלַ֗דְתִּי וְלֹ֥א וְלֹֽא־ גִדַּ֛לְתִּי בַּחוּרִ֖ים רוֹמַ֥מְתִּי בְתוּלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bō·wō·šî ṣî·ḏō·wn mā·‘ō·wz yām kî- hay·yām lê·mōr ’ā·mar lō- ḥal·tî yā·laḏ·tî wə·lō wə·lō- ḡid·dal·tî ba·ḥū·rîm rō·w·mam·tî ḇə·ṯū·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Be ashamed O Sidon the stronghold of the sea for the sea . . . has spoken I have not been in labor or given birth . . . I have not raised young men or brought up young women

verses.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ שֵׁ֖מַע לְמִצְרָ֑יִם יָחִ֖ילוּ כְּשֵׁ֥מַע צֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer- šê·ma‘ lə·miṣ·rā·yim yā·ḥî·lū kə·šê·ma‘ ṣōr
verses.literal: When the report [reaches] Egypt they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre
Cross over to Tarshish wail O inhabitants of the coastland

verses.original: הֲזֹ֥את לָכֶ֖ם עַלִּיזָ֑ה קַדְמָתָהּ֙ קֶ֤דֶם מִֽימֵי־ רַגְלֶ֔יהָ יֹבִל֣וּהָ לָגֽוּר׃ מֵֽרָח֖וֹק
verses.transliteration: hă·zōṯ lā·ḵem ‘al·lî·zāh qaḏ·mā·ṯāh qe·ḏem mî·mê- raḡ·le·hā yō·ḇi·lū·hā lā·ḡūr mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: Is this your jubilant city whose origin is from antiquity . . . whose feet have taken her to settle far away

verses.original: מִ֚י יָעַ֣ץ זֹ֔את עַל־ צֹ֖ר הַמַּֽעֲטִירָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר סֹחֲרֶ֙יה֙ שָׂרִ֔ים כִּנְעָנֶ֖יהָ נִכְבַּדֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mî yā·‘aṣ zōṯ ‘al- ṣōr ham·ma·‘ă·ṭî·rāh ’ă·šer sō·ḥă·reh śā·rîm kin·‘ā·ne·hā niḵ·bad·dê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Who planned this against Tyre the bestower of crowns whose traders are princes whose merchants are renowned on the earth

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יְעָצָ֑הּ לְחַלֵּל֙ כָּל־ גְּא֣וֹן צְבִ֔י לְהָקֵ֖ל כָּל־ נִכְבַּדֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yə·‘ā·ṣāh lə·ḥal·lêl kāl- gə·’ō·wn ṣə·ḇî lə·hā·qêl kāl- niḵ·bad·dê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts planned it to defile all its glorious beauty to disgrace all the renowned of the earth

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י אַרְצֵ֖ךְ כַּיְאֹ֑ר בַּת־ תַּרְשִׁ֕ישׁ אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃ מֵ֥זַח
verses.literal: Cultivate your land like the Nile O Daughter of Tarshish there is no longer a harbor

verses.original: נָטָ֣ה יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם מַמְלָכ֑וֹת הִרְגִּ֖יז יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶל־ מָעֻזְנֶֽיהָ׃ כְּנַ֔עַן לַשְׁמִ֖ד
verses.transliteration: nā·ṭāh yā·ḏōw ‘al- hay·yām mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ hir·gîz Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’el- mā·‘uz·ne·hā kə·na·‘an laš·miḏ
verses.literal: [The LORD] has stretched out His hand over the sea He has made kingdoms tremble [He] has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לַעְל֑וֹז לֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֥יפִי ע֖וֹד הַֽמְעֻשָּׁקָ֞ה בְּתוּלַ֣ת בַּת־ צִיד֗וֹן ק֣וּמִי עֲבֹ֔רִי כִּתִּיִּים גַּם־ שָׁ֖ם לֹא־ יָנ֥וּחַֽ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la‘·lō·wz lō- ṯō·w·sî·p̄î ‘ō·wḏ ham·‘uš·šā·qāh bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ṣî·ḏō·wn qū·mî ‘ă·ḇō·rî kit·tī·yīm gam- šām lō- yā·nū·aḥ lāḵ
verses.literal: He said You shall rejoice no more . . . O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon Get up and cross over to Cyprus even there you will find no rest

verses.original: הֵ֣ן׀ אֶ֣רֶץ זֶ֤ה כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הָעָם֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה אַשּׁ֖וּר יְסָדָ֣הּ לְצִיִּ֑ים הֵקִ֣ימוּ בְחִינָיו עֹרְרוּ֙ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שָׂמָ֖הּ לְמַפֵּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’e·reṣ zeh kaś·dîm hā·‘ām lō hā·yāh ’aš·šūr yə·sā·ḏāh lə·ṣî·yîm hê·qî·mū ḇə·ḥī·nå̄w ‘ō·rə·rū ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā śā·māh lə·map·pê·lāh
verses.literal: Look at the land of the Chaldeans a people now of no account The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces They brought it to ruin

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּ֥י מָעֻזְּכֶֽן׃ס שֻׁדַּ֖ד
verses.literal: Wail O ships of Tarshish for your harbor has been destroyed

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם צֹר֙ וְנִשְׁכַּ֤חַת שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה כִּימֵ֖י אֶחָ֑ד מֶ֣לֶךְ מִקֵּ֞ץ שִׁבְעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לְצֹ֔ר כְּשִׁירַ֖ת הַזּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm ṣōr wə·niš·ka·ḥaṯ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh kî·mê ’e·ḥāḏ me·leḵ miq·qêṣ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh yih·yeh lə·ṣōr kə·šî·raṯ haz·zō·w·nāh
verses.literal: - At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years the span of a king’s life But at the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot

verses.original: קְחִ֥י כִנּ֛וֹר סֹ֥בִּי עִ֖יר נִשְׁכָּחָ֑ה זוֹנָ֣ה הֵיטִ֤יבִי נַגֵּן֙ הַרְבִּי־ שִׁ֔יר לְמַ֖עַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥî ḵin·nō·wr sōb·bî ‘îr niš·kā·ḥāh zō·w·nāh hê·ṭî·ḇî nag·gên har·bî- šîr lə·ma·‘an tiz·zā·ḵê·rî
verses.literal: Take up your harp stroll through the city O forgotten harlot Make sweet melody sing many a song . . . so you will be remembered

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יִפְקֹ֤ד צֹ֔ר וְשָׁבָ֖ה לְאֶתְנַנָּ֑ה וְזָֽנְתָ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh miq·qêṣ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- yip̄·qōḏ ṣōr wə·šā·ḇāh lə·’eṯ·nan·nāh wə·zā·nə·ṯāh ’eṯ- kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: And at the end of seventy years the LORD - will restore Tyre Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms - on the face of the earth

verses.original: סַחְרָ֜הּ וְאֶתְנַנָּ֗הּ וְהָיָ֨ה קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵֽאָצֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יֵֽחָסֵ֑ן כִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֣ה סַחְרָ֔הּ לַיֹּשְׁבִ֞ים לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְשָׂבְעָ֖ה לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָתִֽיק׃פ וְלִמְכַסֶּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: saḥ·rāh wə·’eṯ·nan·nāh wə·hā·yāh qō·ḏeš Yah·weh lō yê·’ā·ṣêr wə·lō yê·ḥā·sên kî yih·yeh saḥ·rāh lay·yō·šə·ḇîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·śā·ḇə·‘āh le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘ā·ṯîq wə·lim·ḵas·seh
verses.literal: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD they will not be stored . . . or saved for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD for abundant food and fine clothing
